title: Quobly and CEA-Leti Strengthen Collaboration via FAMES Pilot Line to Scale 300 mm Silicon Spin-Qubit Platform - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quobly gained access to Europe's Chips JU FAMES pilot line at CEA-Leti to prototype 3D integration, RF control and eNVM for its 300 mm FD-SOI silicon spin-qubit QSOI platform, bridging R&D and STMicroelectronics foundry runs, with first cloud processors (Alloy Pioneer) planned for late 2026 and fault tolerance targeted by 2032.

insights.claim: Quobly's QSOI architecture integrates silicon spin qubits and cryogenic control electronics on a unified die on 300 mm FD-SOI CMOS substrates, leveraging VLSI manufacturing principles.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Silicon spin qubits bet on reusing the trillion-dollar semiconductor toolchain — a potential scaling advantage over bespoke modalities.
insights.quote: integrates silicon spin qubits directly onto a 300 mm fully depleted silicon-on-insulator (FD-SOI) CMOS substrate

insights.claim: Using FAMES's 3D integration and embedded non-volatile memory capabilities, Quobly aims to scale qubit density and pulse-control performance on standard 300 mm lines without expanding thermal or physical footprints.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Footprint and heat budget inside cryostats are key scaling bottlenecks; 3D integration addresses them.

insights.claim: The FAMES pilot line, hosted at CEA-Leti in Grenoble under Chips JU, serves as an intermediate prototyping bridge between exploratory R&D and commercial foundry runs at STMicroelectronics.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: European public pilot lines lower capex for quantum startups and reinforce STMicro's role as a quantum foundry.
insights.quote: Access to FAMES establishes an intermediate prototyping bridge between exploratory R&D and commercial foundry runs at STMicroelectronics.

insights.claim: Air Liquide, Soitec and Orano form Quobly's specialized supply chain for isotopically purified silicon-28 substrate materials.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Isotopically purified Si-28 is a niche but strategic input; listed European industrials gain small optionality from spin-qubit scaling.

insights.claim: Quobly plans initial cloud availability of its first-generation processor family, Alloy Pioneer, by late 2026 and targets large-scale fault-tolerant silicon architectures by 2032.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Concrete dated milestones to track Quobly's execution against peers like Diraq.
insights.quote: targeting a long-term scaling trajectory toward large-scale, fault-tolerant silicon architectures by 2032
